Jwt._Key: Set via user-secrets or the Jwt__Key env var — do NOT commit a real key.
Jwt._ExpiryMinutes: Short-lived access token; the silent /auth/refresh flow keeps the session alive.

Email._Provider: 'cloudflare' (Cloudflare Email Service — also needs AccountId) or 'resend'. Blank defaults to resend.
Email._ApiKey: Provider API key/token — set via user-secrets or the Email__ApiKey env var; without it emails are logged, not sent.
Email._AccountId: Cloudflare account id (Cloudflare only — its send endpoint is account-scoped).
Email._AppBaseUrl: Origin used for links inside emails (config-only on purpose — never derived from request headers).
